subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three deterministic guard repairs, should the reviewed secret-bearing, publishing, scanning, builder, and Codex action revisions be accepted together in this batch?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical, but accepting grouped third-party code-execution changes across privileged workflows requires explicit repository security and automation ownership.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Accept the reviewed revisions once all three assertions match and exact-head workflow and security checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and builder revisions into smaller owner-reviewed pull requests.

options.title: Defer this batch
options.body: Keep the current trusted pins until the privileged upstream deltas can be reviewed with sufficient confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed revisions once all three assertions match and exact-head workflow and security checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest individual ownership signal across the affected central CI guard and performance automation surfaces.
